metadata.description: Alpha distribution channel for Magus — experimental plugins with partial wiring, TODO-gaps, and evolving interfaces. Source of truth: MadAppGang/magus-src. This is a lean dist repo.

plugins.name: autolinear
plugins.description: Autonomous Linear to Claude Code bridge. Picks up issues labelled @autolinear, routes them to agents by tag, captures proof-of-work, and drives each issue from Todo to Done with reviewer feedback loops. Alpha: manual /autolinear:run is end to end; webhook pickup stops at a dispatch stub.
